meta.name: provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪系统的每一步操作，留作可审计的证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在维护多智能体系统，需要完整操作日志做安全审计
copy.tagline_en: Trace every operation across your system to build an auditable evidence chain
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a multi-agent system and need full operation logs for security audit

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把关键操作事件记录成可追溯的证据链并生成向量索引；同时提供按 trace_id、时间窗或官署检索历史事件的接口，用于审计与回滚定位。
howto.when: 当系统在关键操作节点（如分发、扫描、解析）调用该技能，或通过事件总线推送事件时，它会写入证据链。

say.text: 运行 provenance，记录刚才的分发和扫描事件。
按 trace_id=abc123 查这一单的完整证据链。
say.note: 返回该 trace 下的全部关联事件。

say.text: 按官署维度列出过去一小时的操作记录。
say.note: 返回符合时间窗与官署维度的证据条目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude records key operation events into a traceable evidence chain and builds vector indexes; it also provides query APIs by trace_id, time-window, or agency for audit and rollback.
howto.when_en: The skill is invoked when a system component calls it at key operation nodes (e.g., dispatch, scan, parse), or when events arrive via the event bus.

say_en.text: Run provenance and log the recent dispatch and scan events.
say_en.note: Produces trace.jsonl and trace_summary.json evidence files.

say_en.text: Retrieve the full evidence chain for trace_id=abc123.
say_en.note: Returns all events linked to that trace.

say_en.text: List operation logs from the past hour by agency.
say_en.note: Returns evidence entries filtered by time window and agency.
